limitations: Full historical flat and nonflat scans were retained, not regenerated.
Lanczos diagnostics are not certified discontinuous-filter error bounds.

No claim of a hard-bin asymptotic rate; the infinite-mode fixed-purity probabilities are shown to converge at all but countably many cutoffs, not at the specific cutoffs used, and their positivity is conjectural.
Prose statistics of the flat scan (window minima, maxima, medians) are read from the archived JSON, not independently recomputed.
Numerical tests are not machine proofs of the analytical arguments.
